claims: Mobbin gives Claude Code access to over 600,000 real design references
Claude can study dozens of real examples, find common patterns and create a plan before writing code
You can hand it an ugly existing site and have it research similar products before redesigning
how_to_steps: Connect the Mobbin MCP to Claude Code (comment 'map' for setup)
Before building a screen, tell Claude to research the best examples of that screen type inside Mobbin
Have it identify shared patterns and write a plan
Tell Claude to build your version using those principles
For redesigns, give it your existing site plus 'research similar products' first
on_screen_only: Mobbin screenshots: Apple TV+ app, 'Account Setup -- First up, which products do you use the most? Mens / Boys / Girls / Womens', workout app 'Push -- Start Workout', card-fan fintech screen, iPhone weather/San Francisco 53

Claude task list: 'Import and audit Stitch design' -> Scaffold Vite + React + TS project; Install Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + dependencies; Build token system (tokens.ts + tailwind.config); Build shared components (FadingVideo, AnimatedSection, WordReveal); Build Nav component
Example 'ugly' site: 'Empowering Your Success with Digital Expertise' digital marketing template

gap.what: Mobbin as an MCP source of real UI patterns is not in the liked set, which covers design skills (Impeccable, Taste, awesome-design, Apple design skill) and clone-site but not a reference database for research-before-build.

relevance.why: Directly improves app screen quality (onboarding, paywalls, dashboards) for a founder with no designer; fits the 'research then build' pattern already used.

implement_score.why: Mobbin is a paid subscription; if the MCP exists on Haji's tier, adding it is a one-time config and a one-line prompt habit. Confirm cost first.

verify: Does Mobbin ship an official MCP and on which plan (Pro?)
